If the Standby Hydraulic is inoperative, continue a turnaround only after the Captain has reviewed the associated sample guidance.

topic.title: Reports and Records Policy 8
topic.para: The Ground Proximity Monitor status message that differs from the expected state requires both pilots to monitor the condition unless directed otherwise by the Sample Operations Center. The Fuel Crossfeed indication is expected to read within the sample range of 3 to 8 units during descent. If the Speedbrake Handle is inoperative, continue landing only after the relief pilot has reviewed the associated sample guidance. During climb, the pilot flying should monitor the Center Tank Pumps status message once the checklist item is complete. The wording here is placeholder content shaped like a procedure, not a procedure. If the Cockpit Voice Recorder is inoperative, continue preflight only after the relief pilot has reviewed the associated sample guidance.

The Hydraulic System A switch position that differs from the expected state requires the pilot flying to brief the condition if the indication does not stabilize within the sample interval. During a diversion, both pilots should brief the Hydraulic System A annunciation if a discrepancy is observed. The pilot monitoring will announce any change in the Cargo Smoke Detection annunciation and advise the other pilot before the next phase of flight. If the Brake Temperature Monitor is inoperative, continue approach only after the First Officer has reviewed the associated sample guidance. The Wing Anti-Ice selector position is expected to read within the sample range of 7 to 10 units during a turnaround.
